title: Tier Benefits Chart: Free Shipping Threshold and Perk Credit — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
Two tier benefits of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** are set per tier: the order subtotal at which standard ship-to-home shipping becomes free, and the perk credit granted with a paid term.

## Free standard ship-to-home shipping

| Tier | Order subtotal at or above which standard ship-to-home shipping is free |
|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | $49.00 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | $49.00 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | $35.00 |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | $0.00 (always free) |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | $0.00 (always free) |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | $0.00 (always free) |

A threshold of $0.00 means shipping is always free for that tier. As a hypothetical check: a $40.00 order subtotal is below the $49.00 threshold but at or above the $35.00 threshold.

## Perk credit

| Tier | Perk credit per membership term | Services the credit may pay for | When it is granted | Unused credit lapses at the end of the term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | $0.00 | none | none | Yes |
| Pals Rewards Insider | $0.00 | none | none | Yes |
| Pals Rewards VIP | $0.00 | none | none | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | $0.00 | none | none | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | $0.00 | none | none | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | $60.00 | grooming, training and vet services | at the start of each term | Yes |

Only Tailwise Plus Premier Annual carries a perk credit: $60 at the start of each membership term, for grooming, training or vet services.
